ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Considering the above food web, if all the arthropods are extinguished, which organism will have to find a new energy source?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This figure is titled “The Soil Food Web”. The figure is labeled with Plants, Organic Matter, Bacteria, Fungi, Protozoa, Nematodes, and two Arthropods nodes: one is “Arthropods Shredders”, and the other is “Arthropods Predators”. On the right side there is a bird node labeled “Birds”. The red arrows in the figure connect the energy relationships in the food web, among which there are arrows from arthropod-related nodes to birds, indicating that birds use arthropods as an energy source. Reasoning: If all arthropods became extinct, then organisms that depend on arthropods as a food source would lose that energy source. The figure directly shows that birds obtain energy from arthropods, so the ones that need to find a new energy source are Birds.
